about: The facts of public.learn_left per oral question, from the site's line rule (frontend/src/lib/exams/learnFacts.ts over cheatSheet.ts buildSheet). Generated by learnFacts.vectors.test.ts (TZ=UTC WRITE_LEARN_LEFT_VECTORS=1); checked against meldy_private.learn_left_facts by supabase/tests/local/learn_left_run.sh. Moments in epoch seconds; do not edit by hand.

cases.name: kinds_and_states
cases.about: Every block kind; a question partly named with a miss, one named in full waiting for another day, one never answered.

cases.name: peek_same_day
cases.about: A naming after a peek of that point the same day does not count; a peek after the naming does not undo it; a peek today moves the ready moment to tomorrow.

cases.name: followup_and_unrated
cases.about: Named only after the examiner asked counts as a miss; an unrated point is ignored.

cases.name: midnight_and_twenty_hours
cases.about: 23:59 and 0:01 are two days but not 20 hours; 1:00 and 21:00 are 20 hours on one day; a third naming completes each.

cases.name: rebuilt_rubric_and_words
cases.about: A rubric rebuilt with the same point keeps its history by the words (case, «ё», punctuation aside); other words do not count; an event with no title falls back to its key.

cases.name: twins_and_one_per_answer
cases.about: Two points of one rubric with the same words are told apart by their ids; one answer names a line once (its own point first, else the lower id).

cases.name: returned_and_due
cases.about: A learned point missed later is not learned again until a new series; a point learned long ago stays learned while its check is due.
